parameters.name: AliyunOrderId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud order ID. This can be a virtual order ID.

parameters.name: PackageType
parameters.description:
The package type. Valid values:

- single\_node\_subscribe: single node (subscription)

- single\_node\_long\_term: single node (long-term)

- primary\_backup\_subscribe: primary/standby (subscription)

- primary\_backup\_long\_term: primary/standby (long-term)

- pre\_generation\_long\_term: pre-generated (long-term)

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records to return on each page.

parameters.name: PurchaseChannel
parameters.description: The purchase channel. Valid values: \`aliyun\_market\` (Alibaba Cloud Marketplace) and \`aliyun\_public\` (standard purchase page).

parameters.name: VirtualOrder
parameters.description: Specifies whether to query only virtual orders.
